description_en: Queries the page view (PV) and unique visitor (UV) data for a specified streaming domain
description_zh: 查询指定直播域名的PV、UV数据
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-domain-pv-uv-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --start-time 2018-03-17T16:00:00Z --end-time 2018-03-20T16:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveDomainPvUvData

parameters.description_en:
The streaming domain.

> - Make sure that the specified domain name is a streaming domain and that you have the required permissions to operate on it.
parameters.description_zh:
播流域名。
> - 传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限。
parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain.

parameters.help_zh:
播流域名。
> - 传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.description_en: The start time. The format is *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ssZ* (UTC).
parameters.help_en: The start time. The format is *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ssZ* (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en: The end time. The time must be later than the start time. The format is *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ssZ* (UTC).
parameters.description_zh: 结束时间，需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
parameters.help_en: The end time. The time must be later than the start time. The format is *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ssZ* (UTC)
